items.followUp: A right-angled triangle has a base of 5 cm and a perpendicular of 12 cm. Find the length of its hypotenuse.

rubric.why: Checks the Pythagorean relation and its substitution using the given lengths in SI units.
rubric.description: Uses the Pythagorean theorem with the given dimensions converted to metres.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the relation and substitution.

rubric.why: Checks the calculated hypotenuse and its unit.
rubric.description: Finds the hypotenuse as 0.05 m (5 cm).
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the correct answer with a unit.

modelAnswer: Given: base = 4 cm = 0.04 m; perpendicular = 3 cm = 0.03 m.
Answer: The length of the hypotenuse is 0.05 m (5 cm).

items.followUp: Using a speed-time graph, derive the equation v = u + at.

rubric.why: Checks that displacement is obtained from the area under the speed-time or velocity-time graph.
rubric.description: Identifies displacement as the area under the graph.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that displacement is the graph area.

rubric.why: Checks the rectangle-plus-triangle expression for the area under the graph.
rubric.description: Writes displacement as the area of the rectangle plus the triangle.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for s = ut + ½(v − u)t.

rubric.why: Checks the acceleration relation used to eliminate time.
rubric.description: Uses the acceleration relation or its rearrangement.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a = (v − u)/t or t = (v − u)/a.

rubric.why: Checks the derived third equation of motion.
rubric.description: Obtains the third equation of motion.

modelAnswer: For uniform acceleration, let the initial velocity be u, final velocity be v, time be t and displacement be s.
Displacement is the area under the speed-time graph: s = area of rectangle + area of triangle.
From the first equation of motion, a = (v − u)/t, so t = (v − u)/a.
Multiplying by 2a and simplifying: 2as = 2u(v − u) + (v − u)² = v² − u².
